## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm verify` (typecheck, lint, Knip, and enforced coverage pass)
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm run doctor`
- [ ] `pnpm run audit` (configured production audit; exceptions documented)
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Relevant native/manual checks completed or described in the pull request

## Documentation

- [ ] Source-of-truth documentation is updated, or no documentation change is needed
